name: Slant Reel
description: Full-screen WebGL reel of image columns tilted diagonally and bent into curves, looping endlessly and driven by smooth scroll velocity.
contents: Fixed full-viewport WebGL canvas with columns of looping images
behavior: Smooth infinite scrolling through Lenis moves the image columns
Each column moves at its own speed and is curved by a vertex shader
Scroll speed warps the image planes, optionally smoothed
Canvas fills the viewport and resizes with it
editableByProps: Images, column count, positions, sizes, gaps, curve and speed per column
Camera distance and tilt, background color, scroll smoothing, loader visibility, Lenis options

needsCodeEdit.change: Change image cropping or add effects to images

fixed: Canvas is position fixed over the full viewport
Takes over page scrolling with Lenis (root mode), so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page; disable with includeLenis=false
